HighamBench.p15_t1_low_rank_matvec_backward_representation {b r : ℕ} (fp : HighamBench.StandardFPModel)
  (X Y : HighamBench.P15RectMatrix b r) (v : HighamBench.P15Vector b) (hb : HighamBench.GammaValid fp.u b)
  (hr : HighamBench.GammaValid fp.u r) :
  have wHat := HighamBench.p15RoundedRectMatVec fp (HighamBench.p15RectTranspose Y) v;
  have zHat := HighamBench.p15RoundedRectMatVec fp X wHat;
  ∃ ΔYT ΔX,
    HighamBench.p15RectFrobNorm ΔYT ≤
        HighamBench.gamma fp.u b * HighamBench.p15RectFrobNorm (HighamBench.p15RectTranspose Y) ∧
      HighamBench.p15RectFrobNorm ΔX ≤ HighamBench.gamma fp.u r * HighamBench.p15RectFrobNorm X ∧
        wHat = HighamBench.p15RectMatVec (HighamBench.p15RectAdd (HighamBench.p15RectTranspose Y) ΔYT) v ∧
          zHat = HighamBench.p15RectMatVec (HighamBench.p15RectAdd X ΔX) wHat ∧
            zHat =
              HighamBench.p15RectMatVec
                (HighamBench.p15RectMatMul (HighamBench.p15RectAdd X ΔX)
                  (HighamBench.p15RectAdd (HighamBench.p15RectTranspose Y) ΔYT))
                v
